DISCOVERY_MECHANISM.not_a_daemon: M4-7 authority excludes runtime lifecycle/deployment; discovery is explicit scanner invocation or store open, not background daemon
DISCOVERY_MECHANISM.scan_method: scan_requiring_recovery scans durable journal for nonterminal states only
DISCOVERY_MECHANISM.predicate: state in eligible_states and journal_revision not stale and correlation lineage active
DISCOVERY_MECHANISM.ordering: deterministic by journal_id lexicographic then created_at; no newest/latest heuristic selection
DISCOVERY_MECHANISM.idempotency_of_scan: scan is read-only; repeated scans without state change return same set

HANDLING_PER_STATE.PREPARED: no durable APPLYING -> FAILED_NO_EFFECT via CAS (proves no external attempt); no external read required
HANDLING_PER_STATE.APPLYING: stranded -> CAS APPLYING->RECONCILING then authoritative read and M4-5 classify
HANDLING_PER_STATE.RECONCILING: re-entrant idempotent readback and classify (retry of verify is safe)

FORBIDDEN: heuristic selection among multiple eligible by recency
